_comment: OpenHands MCP server template. Register with the CLI (`openhands mcp add`) or copy to ~/.openhands/mcp.json. The CLI-managed file adds transport/type/cwd/timeout/keep_alive/description/icon/authentication/enabled keys.

github._comment: requires a GitHub PAT with repo scope; set it before use

remote-http-example._comment: HTTP/SSE transport with header auth (disabled by default)
